summary.text: Reive Pullen is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Lee Snodgrass.
His campaign website describes him as a U.S. Marine, Eagle Scout and small business owner from Appleton.

paragraphs.text: Pullen's campaign website says he served in the Marine Corps Reserve with Fox Company, 2nd Battalion, 24th Marines, based in Milwaukee.

It says he earned an associate degree in criminal justice from Fox Valley Technical College while working as a Community Service Officer with the Appleton Police Department and later as a 911 dispatcher for the Shawano County Sheriff's Office.
It says he operates a food, beverage and coffee convenience service for workplaces in the Fox Valley, and that he belongs to the American Legion and Appleton Concerned Taxpayers.
The site lists his key priorities as strong schools, lowering costs for families, local businesses, fiscal responsibility and public safety.
